subject.title: docs(gateway): add launchd supervisor loop troubleshooting

question: Should OpenClaw publish this docs-first launchd recovery runbook before generated-wrapper and doctor/install fixes ship?
rationale: The PR is docs-only and source-backed, but it recommends operator launchd mutations that can affect node-service availability, which needs maintainer intent rather than automated repair.

options.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
options.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

options.title: Require Safer Operator Wording
options.body: Ask for stricter prerequisites or clearer remote-node warning language before merge.

options.title: Hold For Runtime Fix
options.body: Defer or close the PR until wrapper generation or doctor/install repair avoids asking users to carry a manual launchd workaround.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Runbook
recommendation.body: Publish the recovery steps with the skip warning and keep runtime hardening tracked in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history across the docs, launchd, service-env, and supervisor-marker surfaces involved in the product choice.
